content: Rewi nuiwarimama
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni Rewi niwemamama: Keritsuni, Kuhati meta Merari.
Kuhati niwemama: 'Amirani, 'Itsaxi, Hewuruni meta 'Utsiheri.
'Amirani niwemama: 'Aruni, Muitsexi meta Miriyami. 'Aruni niwemama: Narawi, 'Awihu, 'Eriyatsaxi meta 'Itamaxi.
'Eriyatsaxi Pinexi paapaya kanayani. Pinexi 'Awitsuha paapaya kanayani,
'Awitsuha Wukihi paapaya kanayani, Wukihi 'Utsihi paapaya kanayani,
'Utsihi Tserahiyaxi paapaya kanayani, Tserahiyaxi Merayuti paapaya kanayani,
Merayuti 'Amariyaxi paapaya kanayani, 'Amariyaxi 'Akituwi paapaya kanayani,
'Akituwi Tsaruki paapaya kanayani, Tsaruki 'Akimatsi paapaya kanayani,
'Akimatsi 'Atsariyaxi paapaya kanayani, 'Atsariyaxi Kuhanahani paapaya kanayani,
Kuhanahani 'Atsariyaxi paapaya kanayani. Mɨkɨ 'Atsariyaxi mawari wewiwame patɨa Tsarumuni tuki mutawewita Kerutsareme.
'Atsariyaxi 'Amariyaxi paapaya kanayani, 'Amariyaxi 'Akituwi paapaya kanayani,
'Akituwi Tsaruki paapaya kanayani, Tsaruki Tsaruni paapaya kanayani,
Tsaruni Kirikiyaxi paapaya kanayani, Kirikiyaxi 'Atsariyaxi paapaya kanayani,
'Atsariyaxi Tserahiyaxi paapaya kanayani, Tserahiyaxi Kutsaraki paapaya kanayani.
Kutsaraki kanehanieni kepauka Yawé Nawukurunutsuxi mupitɨa Kura meta Kerutsareme kiekatari muwaranuhapanikɨ.
Rewi niwemama mekanakɨne Keritsuni, Kuhati meta Merari.
Keritsuni niwemama: Riwini meta Tsimi.
Kuhati niwemama: 'Amirani, 'Itsaxi, Hewuruni meta 'Utsiheri.
Merari niwemama: Makiri meta Mutsihí. 'Ikɨ mekanakɨne rewitsixi wanuiwarima yuxexuitɨ yutɨɨriyama kememɨtewarayexei.
Keritsuni nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: Riwini, Yakati, Tsimaha,
Kuha, 'Iru, Tsera meta Yatɨrahi.
Kuhati nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: 'Aminarawi, Kure, 'Atsixi,
'Erikana, 'Ewihatsahapi, 'Atsixi,
Takati, 'Uriheri, 'Utsiyaxi meta Tsahuri.
'Erikana niwemama mekanakɨne: 'Amatsahi meta 'Akimuti.
'Akimuti nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: 'Erikana, Tsupahi, Nakati,
'Eriyáwi, Keruhani meta 'Erikana.
Tsamuheri niwemama mekanakɨne: Watsini matɨari mieme, meta 'Awiyaxi.
Merari nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: Makiri, Riwini, Tsimi, 'Utsa,
Tsimaha, Kakiyaxi meta 'Atsahiyaxi.
Tukita kwikamete
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni kwikamete Rawiri muwaranayexei Yawé tukieyata memɨmiemetetɨnikɨ, kepaukapaitɨ tɨratu kakuniyari muwa meutatekie.

Mɨkɨ meputikwikakairi 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwekaitsie, hɨxiena meti'uwetɨ, Tsarumuni 'akuxi tuki katawewiwekaku Yawé hetsiemieme Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie. Hikɨ tawari mekanitsutɨani yu'uximayatsika kememɨte'uhɨritɨariekai.
'Ikɨ meta niwemama kwikari mepɨhɨritɨariekai: Kuhati nuiwarimama, kwikame Hemani Kuheri kaninu'ayatɨkaitɨni, Tsamuheri nuiwarieyatsie mieme,
'Erikana, Keruhani, 'Eriheri, Tuha,
Tsupi, 'Erikana, Mahati, 'Amatsahi,
'Erikana, Kuheri, 'Atsariyaxi, Tsupuniyaxi,
Takati, 'Atsixi, 'Ewihatsahapi, Kure,
'Itsaxi, Kuhati, Rewi meta 'Ixaheri.
Hemani tserieta 'iwaya kaniutikekakaitɨni 'Atsahapi Werekiyaxi nu'aya, Tsimaha nuiwarieya hetsiemieme,
Mikaheri, Watsehiyaxi, Marikiyaxi,
'Etini, Tsera, 'Arahiyaxi,
'Etani, Tsimaha, Tsimi,
Yakati, Keritsuni meta Rewi.
Hemani 'utatana 'Etani kaniutikekakaitɨni Kitsihi nu'aya, wa'iwa kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni meraritsixi wahetsiemieme, 'Awuri, Maruki,
Katsawiyaxi, 'Amatsiyaxi, Kirikiyaxi,
'Amɨtsí, Wanihi, Tsemexi,
Makiri, Mutsihí, Merari meta Rewi.
Wa'iwama rewitsixi mekateni'uximayakaitɨni Kakaɨyari tukieyata.

'Aruni meta niwemama mepɨhɨritɨariekai mawari memutitaiyanikɨ mawari taiyametsie, meta 'ɨkwa taiyametsie. Kemɨtiu'aitaxɨ Muitsexi, Kakaɨyari ti'uximayatsiriwame meta mekanihɨritɨariekaitɨni Waɨkawa Muyepatsietsie hepaɨtsita muwa 'ixaheritsixi wahetsiemieme 'itiya mawariyari memɨwewiekakɨ.
'Aruni nuiwarimama mekanakɨne: 'Eriyatsaxi, Pinexi, 'Awitsuha,
Wukihi, 'Utsihi, Tserahiyaxi,
Merayuti, 'Amariyaxi, 'Akituwi,
Tsaruki meta 'Akimatsi.
Rewitsixi wakiekarite
Kememɨte'ukutetɨkatei 'Aruni nuiwarimama. Kuhati nuiwarimama meri kwie mekaniyetuiriyarieni 'inɨarikɨ,
Hewuruni Kura kwieyaritsie, kwie hautinɨkame hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni.
Karewi Kepune nu'aya, kiekari kwieyari katiniunake meta 'auriena mamanetɨka kiekari 'etsimɨyeyeu.
'Aruni nuiwarimama mekaniyetuiriyarieni kiekarite 'ixaheritsixi wahetsie nunuwame, pɨhɨkɨtɨkai: Hewuruni, Riwina, Katixi, 'Etsitemuha,
Hireni, Rewixi,
'Atsani meta Weti-Tsemetsi, kwie heutinɨtɨkaime memɨtehatihɨwenitsie.

Wenikamini nuiwarimama wakwietsieta mekaniyetuiriyarieni: Kehewa, 'Aremeti meta 'Anatuti, kwie heutinɨtɨkaime hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni. Naitɨ tamamata heimana haika kiekariyari mekaniyetuiriyarieni, yutɨɨriyama kememɨtewarexeiyakai.
Kuhati nuiwarimama memuyuhayewaxɨ mepɨyetuiriyarie 'inɨarikɨ tamamata kiekariyari Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨata memɨ'axe wakwieyaritsie.

Keritsuni nuiwarimama, kememɨyupaɨmekai watɨɨriyama, mekaniyetuiriyarieni tamamata heimana haika kiekariyari 'Itsakaxi, 'Atsexi meta Nepɨtahari wanuiwarima wakwieyaritetsie, metatsiere Manatsexi nuiwarimama Watsani memuyuhayewaxɨ wakwieyaritsie.
Merari nuiwarimama, watɨɨriyama kememɨyupaɨmekai, mekaniyetuiriyarieni 'inɨarikɨ tamamata heimana huta kiekariyari Xuweni, Kahari meta Tsawuruni wakwieyaritetsie miemete.
'Ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ rewitsixi mekateniwayetuirieni kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Mekaniwayetuirieni 'inɨarikɨ Kura nuiwarimama wakiekarite Tsimehuni meta Wenikamini, meripaitɨri memutiterɨwariekai.
Hipatɨta Kuhati nuiwarimama 'inɨarikɨ mekaniyetuiriyarieni kiekarite 'Epɨrahini kwieyaritsie miemete.
Kiekari teɨteri wahetsie nunuwame mekaniyetuiriyarieni Tsikeni 'Epɨrahini yemuriyaritetsie, Ketsehexi,
Kumehani, Weti-Kuruni,
'Ayaruni meta Kahati-Ximuni, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Hipatɨta Kuhati nuiwarimama mekaniyetuiriyarieni 'Anexi meta Wirehani kiekariteyari Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨata memɨ'axe wakwieyaritsie mieme, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.

Keritsuni nuiwarimama mekaniyetuiriyarieni Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨata memɨ'axe wakwieyaritsie mieme: Kurani Watsani kwieyaritsie mieme, meta 'Atsitaruti, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
'Itsakaxi nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie mekaniyetuiriyarieni: Tseretsi, Tawerati,
Xamuti meta 'Aneni, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
'Atsexi nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie mekaniyetuiriyarieni Matsari, 'Awuruni,
Hukuki meta Xekuwi, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Nepɨtahari nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie mekaniyetuiriyarieni Tseretsi Karereya kwieyaritsie mieme, Hamuni meta Kiriyatahini, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Hipatɨta Merari nuiwarimama mekaniyetuiriyarieni kiekarite Tsawuruni nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie miemete: Ximuni meta Tawuxi, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Xuweni nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie miemete, Kurutani hatetsitayaritsie tau manatineika hepatsie mukuma, Keriku 'anutaɨye mekaniyetuiriyarieni, Wetsexi makumawetsie mɨti'ane, Katsa,
Karemuti meta Mepati, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
Kahari nuiwarimama wakwieyaritsie mekaniyetuiriyarieni Xamuti Karaha kwieyaritsie, Makanahini,
Hetsiwuni meta Katsexi, kwie hakewa memɨtehetihɨweni heutinɨtɨkaime.
